findings.title: Optional genre AI blocks playback and every other listener operation while waiting for external inference
findings.preconditions: Authenticated onboarded listener with nonempty imported artist summary and Workers AI configured; playback active.
reproduction: Use actual UserHub class, stubbing only cloudflare:workers DurableObject constructor for Node, and inject real HubCore/FakeSpotify harness.
Start u.estimateGenres(sessionEpoch) with AI run Promise held unresolved.
After AI is entered call u.playerAction(epoch,pause).
After100ms pause still unresolved and provider transport untouched. Release AI promise; estimate completes, then pause succeeds.
findings.expected: Optional profile inference must not own the account-wide player/state lock for an unbounded remote wait; owner pause/device actions and observation must remain responsive, with fenced publication of the eventual estimate.
findings.actual: estimateGenres uses session→exclusive and awaits the entire provider call. All later operations queue behind it. Workers AI path has no deadline; installed Anthropic SDK constructor here uses defaults timeout10minutes and maxRetries2 (source-read, not a live latency measurement).
findings.repair_direction: Move optional inference off critical per-listener lock with bounded attempt/publish lifecycle, retain epoch/account/generation fencing and cache/coalescing; add bounded provider timeout/retry policy.
required_regressions: AI timeout/failure and eventual stale completion
Concurrent requests coalesce; newer import/account state prevents stale publication

findings.title: Six-hour genre gate disappears on provider failures/refusals and permits immediate repeated paid requests
reproduction: Store valid imported summary with positive artist minutes.
Use Workers AI returning response refused (unusable JSON).
Call estimateGenres three times at unchanged clock, restarting HubCore between attempts.
findings.expected: Documented at-most-every-six-hours inference/request policy must cover failed or refused attempts durably, preserve old successful result and provide honest retry timing.
findings.actual: Three AI calls occur (test expected1, observed3). Only successful genre_estimate.at is stored. No successful estimate, or an expired previous result, leaves each retry immediately eligible; persists across restart.
findings.repair_direction: Store bounded durable attempt deadline before issuing inference, with concurrency protection; retain previous result, distinguish attempt/retry from successful-estimate age and provider429 if provided.
required_regressions: Expired successful estimate then repeated failures

findings.title: Imported month validation coerces non-string JSON values and persists client-incompatible shape
reproduction: setImportedProfile accepts and persists the array because String(month) matches regex.
Client monthLabel calls month.split on that stored array.
findings.expected: Reject non-string month before storage; preserve prior valid summary.
findings.actual: Assertion expecting bad_profile rejection fails. Static client split/slice usage shows incompatible stored shape. Actual malformed-data rendered browser was not run by this reviewer.
findings.impact: Malformed authenticated self-supplied API payload can break that account profile display; normal browser builder generates strings, so not promoted release-blocking.
findings.repair_direction: Use strict typeof month string plus valid1..12 month and unique/order validation.

findings.title: Malformed extended-history infinite ms yields nonfinite summary which server rejects and upload flow silently discards
reproduction: Supply valid trackURI/timestamp with ms_played Infinity (JSON exponent1e400 also parses to Infinity).
finishProfile returns minutes Infinity instead of refusing; JSON upload yields null and server validation rejects.
findings.actual: Independent malformed-input assertion fails; normal Spotify export has finite ms. UI upload catches summary errors and reports completed legacy import; actual rendered error flow delegated to separate UI review.
findings.repair_direction: Validate finite/bounded played milliseconds; show summary failure explicitly while retaining legacy import result.
